notes: 8 steps: 3 prerequisite, 1 anchor, 4 follow-up. Planned by deepseek-v4-pro:cloud.

steps.title: Learning representations by back-propagating errors
steps.teaches: Training neural networks by gradient descent via backpropagation
steps.why_here: Dropout is a regularization technique applied during neural network training; the reader must first understand how networks are trained with backpropagation.

steps.title: A Practical Bayesian Framework for Backpropagation Networks
steps.teaches: Overfitting and regularization in neural networks
steps.why_here: Dropout addresses overfitting, so this step introduces the problem of overfitting and classical regularization approaches, building on backpropagation.

steps.title: Bagging Predictors
steps.why_here: Dropout approximates an ensemble of subnetworks; bagging provides the conceptual foundation for why averaging multiple models improves generalization.

steps.title: Dropout: a simple way to prevent neural networks from overfitting
steps.teaches: Randomly dropping units during training to prevent co-adaptation
steps.why_here: This is the core paper that introduces dropout, combining the regularization goal from step 2 with the ensemble idea from step 3.

steps.title: Understanding Dropout
steps.teaches: Analysis of dropout as ensemble averaging and adaptive regularization
steps.why_here: After the anchor, this paper provides a theoretical analysis of why dropout works, explicitly connecting it to the bagging concept from step 3.

steps.title: Dropout as a Bayesian Approximation: Representing Model Uncertainty in\n Deep Learning
steps.why_here: Building on the empirical understanding from step 5, this paper gives a Bayesian interpretation of dropout, linking it to model uncertainty.

steps.title: Variational Dropout and the Local Reparameterization Trick
steps.teaches: Learning per-weight dropout rates via variational inference
steps.why_here: Extends the Bayesian view from step 6 by making dropout rates learnable parameters, improving regularization adaptivity.

steps.title: Concrete Dropout
steps.teaches: Automatic tuning of dropout rate with continuous relaxation
steps.why_here: Further automates dropout rate selection, building on the variational dropout framework from step 7 to provide a practical adaptive method.
